title: chrysothamnus parryi var. affinis
intro: Chrysothamnus parryi var. affinis, commonly known as Bigelow sagebrush, is a flowering shrub native to the western United States and Canada. This plant has been traditionally used in herbal medicine due to its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Bigelow sagebrush include its ability to reduce inflammation, improve wound healing, and exhibit antimicrobial activity, making it useful for treating skin conditions and infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpenes, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
